vulnerability.name: USN-6663-2
vulnerability.description: USN-6663-1 provided a security update for OpenSSL. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   As a security improvement, this update prevents OpenSSL  from returning an error when detecting wrong padding  in PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA, to prevent its use in possible  Bleichenbacher timing attacks.

statements.status_notes: Add implicit rejection in PKCS#1 v1.5 in OpenSSL. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
